In appeal the Appellate Assistant Commissioner and the Appellate Tribunal held that the assessee was assessed as a "Hindu Undivided Family" and that as it maintained its books of account in accordance with the cash system of accounting the accrued interest was liable to be included in the wealth tax assessments of the assessee. The appellant, a Hindu undivided family, was assessed to income tax in the hands of the respondents under section 34 of the Income tax Act, 1922, and the Income tax Officer assessed the amounts in the hands Of the heirs and legal representatives of the deceased.
